story_candidates.title: What PagerDuty says it learned running AI agents in production
story_candidates.angle: PagerDuty's own engineering post, written from a year of running a multi-agent system, names the failures it met (context fatigue, errors compounding across steps, one agent building on another's wrong hypothesis) and the controls it chose (a supervisor with domain sub-agents, visible reasoning, a kill switch from day one). Its 3 Nov announcement of the Paige SRE agent shows the same limits in the product: customer-set boundaries and permission before it resolves anything.
